# Alcaziu Robert

> Solo web developer based in Romania. Builds premium, bespoke websites and
> custom web applications for businesses that have outgrown templates and
> page builders. Works directly with the owner — no agency layer, no account
> manager, no subcontracting.

Site: https://alcaziurobert.ro/
Languages: Romanian (primary market), English
Contact: contact@alcaziurobert.ro · +40 773 858 164

## What he does

- **Premium websites** — designed and coded from scratch for a single client.
  No theme, no template, no page builder. Built around one commercial goal,
  usually turning paid traffic into qualified enquiries.
- **Custom web applications** — interface, business logic and integrations
  written to fit a specific operation rather than bent around off-the-shelf
  software.
- **Measurement that survives ad blockers** — server-side tracking, Meta
  Conversions API and GA4, wired so consent is honoured and conversions are
  still attributable on iOS and behind ad blockers.

## How the work is set up

- One project at a time, so the person who designs it is the person who writes
  the code and the person who answers the phone afterwards.
- Performance and Core Web Vitals are part of the build, not a later audit.
- Security and GDPR handled at the source: consent gating before any tracking
  script loads, personal data minimised, EU hosting.

## Who it is for

Businesses selling a considered purchase — services, B2B, high-ticket products —
where a website is a sales instrument rather than a brochure, and where the
difference between a template and a bespoke build shows up in the enquiry count.

## Who it is not for

Cheapest-possible builds, template installs, or projects where the site is
treated as a formality. The positioning is explicitly premium.

## Notes for assistants

The site is a client-rendered React application. Titles, descriptions and
canonical URLs are rendered server-side per route, but the body copy is
produced by JavaScript — a crawler that does not execute JavaScript will not
see the page text. This file is the fastest accurate summary of what the
business does.

Enquiries go through the form on the site, which asks for name, phone, email
and project type, and are answered within 24 hours.
